summary: Preserve Buffer backing-store metadata and sharing behavior of subarray and deprecated slice.

target.notes: Buffer.subarray and Buffer.slice both create sharing views. Buffer.slice must not be lowered to Uint8Array.prototype.slice, which copies.

semantics.byteOffset: visible view offset; may be nonzero for pooled buffers

caveats: When reconstructing from buf.buffer, apply buf.byteOffset and buf.byteLength or pooled bytes outside the Buffer may become visible.
references: Node.js Buffer API: buf.subarray, buf.slice, buffer/byteOffset/byteLength

tests.name: subarray shares
tests.input: const {Buffer}=require("node:buffer"); const a=Buffer.from([1,2]); const b=a.subarray(1); b[0]=9; console.log(a[1]);

tests.name: Buffer slice shares unlike Uint8Array slice
tests.input: const {Buffer}=require("node:buffer"); const a=Buffer.from([1,2]); const b=a.slice(1); b[0]=9; const c=Uint8Array.prototype.slice.call(a,0,1); c[0]=7; console.log(a[1],a[0]);

tests.name: metadata respects explicit view
tests.input: const {Buffer}=require("node:buffer"); const a=new ArrayBuffer(8); const b=Buffer.from(a,2,3); console.log(b.buffer===a,b.byteOffset,b.byteLength,b.length);
